Xylos's Magnificent Structure. A magnificent, multi-layered structure on Xylos, resembling a whimsical, futuristic building or spacecraft. Its white oval main body is adorned with diamond-shaped windows of red, yellow, blue, and green, topped with slender yellow and red spires. Smaller, bulbous pods and platforms with colorful windows extend from its sides. The underside is a complex, organic mass of colorful elements. Elongated, pendulum-like ornaments and banners dangle from the structure. A graceful, curving white staircase with glowing yellow details descends from the lower part of the main structure towards the ground. A small, delicate character with short, light blonde hair, wearing a frilly, light-colored dress with a full skirt and short sleeves, stands at the base, holding a large cluster of bright yellow flowers or objects, her bare legs extending into white knee-high coverings. The weather is clear at midday.

SCENE LAYERS:
- Background: A vast, clear, deep blue sky stretches above, hinting at a distant, possibly alien horizon. The light suggests midday, casting crisp shadows.
- Midground: The magnificent, multi-layered Xylos's Magnificent Structure dominates the midground. Its white oval main body is studded with diamond-shaped windows of vibrant red, yellow, blue, and green. Slender yellow and red spires pierce the sky from its apex. Smaller, bulbous pods and platforms, also featuring colorful windows, extend organically from its sides. The underside reveals a complex, almost living mass of colorful, interwoven elements. Elongated, pendulum-like ornaments and flowing banners add a festive, dynamic quality to its form. A graceful, curving white staircase, highlighted with glowing yellow details, descends from the lower section of the main structure.
- Foreground: At the base of the structure, a small, delicate character with short, light blonde hair stands. She wears a frilly, light-colored dress with a full skirt and short sleeves. Her bare legs transition into white knee-high coverings. She holds a large cluster of bright yellow flowers, their vibrant hue contrasting with the earthy tones of the surrounding terrain. The ground appears to be an orange-brown sandy terrain with patches of sparse green vegetation, consistent with an alien or otherworldly environment.

LIGHTING: Bright daylight illuminates the scene, creating sharp contrasts. The midday sun casts a clear, direct light on the structure, emphasizing its vibrant colors and intricate details. The glowing yellow details on the staircase provide a localized, softer luminescence. Shadows are distinct and well-defined.
ATMOSPHERE: The overall mood is vibrant, surreal, and fantastical, exuding a whimsical and futuristic essence. The magnificence of the structure, coupled with the delicate character and the alien landscape, creates an otherworldly and serene, yet festive, atmosphere.

Visual Identity: surreal landscapes, whimsical design, futuristic structures, alien flora, futuristic structures, whimsical design
Forms & Materials: smooth, organic shapes, crystalline formations, sandy terrain, smooth, organic shapes

[SPACE:] EXTERIOR - OUTSIDE view of the building/location
[ENVIRONMENT:] clear, midday
[CAMERA:] camera positioned on approach path with elevated perspective, 25-30° downward tilt, ultra-wide view capturing entrance within broader environmental context, entrance visible but not dominating frame, extensive surroundings visible, layered depth from immediate foreground through distant background, balanced composition showing full architectural context
[LENS:] 12-24mm ultra-wide lens, elevated perspective, expansive framing
[LIGHT:] directional natural light with atmospheric haze, environmental motion (wind-blown mist, drifting clouds, shifting shadows), parallax depth through weather conditions

[NEG:] interior, indoor, inside room, indoor scene

[FILTER: NoLivingSubjects] DON'T INCLUDE: humans, people, faces, characters, animals, creatures, silhouettes, bodies, watermark, signature.

Xylos. A vibrant, surreal alien landscape bathed in bright daylight under a clear, deep blue sky with a distant pink-orange celestial body. The terrain is an orange-brown sandy expanse dotted with patches of green vegetation. Structures feature red-rimmed oval windows and are primarily constructed with earthy tones, white, red, yellow, blue, and green. A lone figure with light blonde hair, wearing a light-colored dress, surveys the scene.

SCENE LAYERS:
- Background: A vast, clear, deep blue sky dominates the upper portion of the view. High in the distance, a soft pink-orange celestial body hangs, casting a gentle glow. The horizon shows the curvature of the planet, transitioning into the orange-brown sandy expanse of the terrain.
- Midground: The orange-brown sandy terrain stretches across the midground, marked by scattered patches of vibrant green alien vegetation. Small, low-lying structures are visible, primarily constructed with earthy tones, white, red, yellow, blue, and green. These buildings are small from this height, featuring distinct red-rimmed oval windows. The overall impression is one of a scattered, organic settlement.
- Foreground: The foreground is a continuation of the orange-brown sandy expanse, with slightly more defined patches of the green vegetation. A lone, tiny figure with light blonde hair, clad in a light-colored dress, stands amidst this landscape, appearing as a minuscule point of detail, surveying the scene below. There are no street-level details or close-up textures.

LIGHTING: Bright daylight illuminates the entire scene, creating sharp, clear shadows. The clear sky allows for direct, unfiltered sunlight, highlighting the vibrant colors of the vegetation and structures. The pink-orange celestial body provides a subtle, secondary light source, casting a warm hue on the distant horizon.
ATMOSPHERE: The atmosphere is clear and serene, imbued with a vibrant, surreal, and alien mood. The overall impression is whimsical and futuristic, with a touch of magnificence. The delicate and graceful arrangement of structures and flora contributes to an otherworldly, fantastical, and even festive ambiance.

Visual Identity: surreal landscapes, whimsical design, futuristic structures, alien flora
Forms & Materials: smooth, organic shapes, crystalline formations, sandy terrain

[CAMERA:] elevated oblique, aerial 45° tilt, wide composition with centered framing, layered depth with foreground elements
[LENS:] 16-35mm wide-angle lens, centered perspective
[LIGHT:] diffused key with parallax through haze, environmental motion (mist, wind, smoke)

[FILTER: NoLivingSubjects] DON'T INCLUDE: humans, people, faces, characters, animals, creatures, silhouettes, bodies, watermark, signature.
